svg.title: Eastern Kalimantan, Makassar Strait and western Sulawesi
svg.metadata: Coastlines: Natural Earth ne_50m_land, public domain. https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/master/geojson/ne_50m_land.geojson . North-up regional crop, with Borneo offset to the right and Sulawesi partially visible at the right edge. Contour patterns are decorative, not measured land or sea elevations. Samarinda marker is approximate: 117.16 E, 0.49 S.
